crossRefs.note: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”
They did so, and made them all sit down.

translations.web: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.
translations.bsb: So they sat down in groups of hundreds and fifties.
translations.kjv: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
translations.asv: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
